Usage: astryx theme eject [options] <slug> [path]

Fork a theme as editable local source

Options:
  -f, --overwrite      Replace existing files. Without it, an existing file fails with ERR_FILE_EXISTS and nothing is written
  --package <package>  Select the package that owns the theme
  -h, --help           display help for command

Exit codes:
  0  all source and descriptor files are written
  1  the theme is unknown or ambiguous, a path escapes, a source file is missing, or a destination exists

Examples:
  # Fork a theme into the local root
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 theme eject ocean
  # Fork one package theme elsewhere
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 theme eject ocean src/themes/my-ocean --package @acme/themes

More: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli/commands/theme-eject
